dedupe_keys.name: ridership per day per stop per timeslot per line

description: Ridership per day per stop per timeslot per line is a dataset listed in Tpg open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Analytical Unit - tpg Exploitation. This dataset concerns 2 lines which are out of TPG Network. Number of users who board a vehicle per stop, per line and per day for M and N lines. These values apply to the whole network without distinction between the Swiss zone and the French zone. Coverage: Geneva (tpg network). The portal files it under Ridership. Its keywords are Ridership, Stop, Line, Boarding Passengers. The portal shows 589,337 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-tpg-ch-portal.
